doc_metadata.title: TC-02.4 — Workflow Management
doc_metadata.caption: Navigate to Workflow. This page shows all configured workflow definitions with their states, transitions, and role-based restrictions.

doc_metadata.title: TC-02.4 — Workflow Definitions
doc_metadata.caption: The workflow management page lists all entity workflows. Each workflow defines states, allowed transitions, and which roles can trigger each transition.

doc_metadata.title: TC-02 — Reports Overview
doc_metadata.caption: The reports page provides analytics and operational insights including asset health, maintenance backlog, work order completion rates, and vendor performance summaries.
